es: Identificar el titular, la petición y el plazo de un mensaje y separar lo esencial del detalle de apoyo, incluso cuando el contexto llega antes.

teaching.en: Lead with the headline and say what you need straight away: we need three more volunteers for Saturday morning, and the list closes on Thursday.
teaching.es: Empieza por el titular y di enseguida lo que necesitas: hacen falta tres voluntarios más para el sábado por la mañana y la lista se cierra el jueves.
teaching.explanationEs: Lead with + nombre: pones primero lo que el lector necesita. El titular dice qué pasa o qué se pide.
segments: Lead with the headline and say what you need straight away: we need
three more volunteers for Saturday morning, and the list closes on Thursday.
teaching.audioText: Lead with the headline and say what you need straight away: we need three more volunteers for Saturday morning, and the list closes on Thursday.

teaching.en: My request is simple: confirm by Thursday noon whether you can cover a shift, because the caterer needs a final number before she places the order.
teaching.es: Mi petición es sencilla: confirma antes del jueves a mediodía si puedes cubrir un turno, porque la empresa de catering necesita un número definitivo antes de hacer el pedido.
teaching.explanationEs: Cover a shift es la colocación habitual para ocupar el turno de otra persona; by + día marca el plazo.
segments: My request is simple: confirm by Thursday noon whether you can cover a
shift, because the caterer needs a final number before she places the order.
teaching.audioText: My request is simple: confirm by Thursday noon whether you can cover a shift, because the caterer needs a final number before she places the order.

teaching.en: Some background can help, but it should follow the request: last year only twelve people came, so we moved the event to a weekend.
teaching.es: Algo de contexto puede ayudar, pero debe ir después de la petición: el año pasado solo vinieron doce personas, así que movimos el evento a un fin de semana.
teaching.explanationEs: El background explica el porqué. Va después de lo que se pide, nunca antes.
segments: Some background can help, but it should follow the request: last year
only twelve people came, so we moved the event to a weekend.
teaching.audioText: Some background can help, but it should follow the request: last year only twelve people came, so we moved the event to a weekend.

teaching.en: To get to the point, separate what is essential from what is merely a detail: the start time is essential, whereas the parking is not.
teaching.es: Para ir al grano, separa lo esencial de lo que es solo un detalle: la hora de inicio es esencial, mientras que el estacionamiento no lo es.
teaching.explanationEs: Essential es lo que el lector necesita para actuar; un detail es información de apoyo que puede esperar.
segments: To get to the point, separate what is essential from what is merely
a detail: the start time is essential, whereas the parking is not.
teaching.audioText: To get to the point, separate what is essential from what is merely a detail: the start time is essential, whereas the parking is not.

teaching.en: If a message hides its request in the third paragraph, readers may miss it, and then nobody will be able to meet a deadline.
teaching.es: Si un mensaje esconde su petición en el tercer párrafo, los lectores pueden pasarla por alto y entonces nadie podrá cumplir un plazo.
teaching.explanationEs: Request es lo que se pide; si queda escondida, el plazo (meet a deadline) se pierde.
segments: If a message hides its request in the third paragraph, readers may
miss it, and then nobody will be able to meet a deadline.
teaching.audioText: If a message hides its request in the third paragraph, readers may miss it, and then nobody will be able to meet a deadline.

teaching.en: The bottom line is that we lack one more volunteer, so please confirm your place today and ask a neighbour to do the same.
teaching.es: La conclusión principal es que nos falta un voluntario más, así que confirma hoy tu plaza y pide a un vecino que haga lo mismo.
teaching.explanationEs: The bottom line is that + oración anuncia la conclusión que el lector debe recordar.
segments: The bottom line is that we lack one more volunteer, so please
confirm your place today and ask a neighbour to do the same.
teaching.audioText: The bottom line is that we lack one more volunteer, so please confirm your place today and ask a neighbour to do the same.

prompt.es: Lee el mensaje y elige su titular: lo que se necesita ahora.

choices.text: Only nine people came to the garden day last spring.
The committee changed the date after a poor turnout.
We are two drivers short for Saturday.

feedback.es: El titular dice qué se necesita ahora: dos conductores; el dato del año pasado y el cambio de fecha son contexto.

hint.es: El titular dice qué se necesita ahora, no qué pasó antes.

origin.text: Hi all. Last spring only nine people came to the garden day, so the committee changed the date. This year we are two drivers short for Saturday. Could anyone help? Please let me know by Thursday.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Podría alguien cubrir un turno en el banco de alimentos?»

feedback.es: Cover a shift es la colocación natural para ocupar el turno de otra persona; take y work también se usan.

hint.es: Es el verbo que se combina con «a shift» cuando alguien ocupa un turno vacío.

origin.text: We are two people short on Saturday morning. Could anyone ___ a shift at the food bank? I will send the final list on Friday.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada expresión con la función que cumple en un mensaje.

pairs.es: da contexto, después de lo esencial

feedback.es: Cada expresión señala qué tipo de información llega: conclusión, contexto, petición o novedad.

hint.es: Piensa en qué pregunta responde cada expresión.

pairs.es: da contexto, después de lo esencial

prompt.es: Escucha la nota y elige qué espera Sara de quienes tienen auto.

choices.text: That they send their names before the weekend.
That they learn the route before Sunday.
That they bring a second driver along with them.

feedback.es: La petición es responder con nombres antes del viernes; la ruta se explicará después y no es lo que pide ahora.

origin.audio: Hi everyone, it's Sara. I'll keep this short, because I know most of you only listen to the first few seconds. We're two drivers short for the food drive on Sunday, so could anyone with a car reply to me by Friday? I'll explain the route afterwards, but the route isn't the point right now. I just need names by Friday.

prompt.es: Elige el mensaje que pone primero lo esencial y deja el contexto para el final.

choices.text: Last year attendance fell, so the committee met twice and changed the day. As a result, we now need two more volunteers for Saturday's shift; please confirm by Thursday.
We need two more volunteers for Saturday's shift; please confirm by Thursday. Some background: attendance fell last year.
Before I ask anything, let me explain how the event began ten years ago. Later I will tell you what we need.

feedback.es: Gana el mensaje que abre con lo que se necesita y con el plazo; el que entierra la petición tras el contexto dice lo mismo, pero el lector tarda en encontrarla.

prompt.es: Completa: «El estacionamiento es un detalle menor, pero todos deben saber la hora.»

feedback.es: Detail es la información de apoyo que no cambia lo que el lector debe hacer, frente a lo esencial.

origin.text: I know you are busy, so I will get to the point: the parking is a minor ___, but everyone must know the start time.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hizo Sara de forma distinta en el mensaje de esta semana.

choices.text: She removed the history of the food drive completely.
She sent the message only to the drivers who had not confirmed.
She moved the request and the deadline to the opening line.

feedback.es: Ahora la primera línea contiene la petición y el plazo; la historia no se elimina, pasa al final como contexto.

origin.audio: At Monday's volunteers' meeting, Sara explained why she had revised the weekly message. Last month, she said, half the group missed the request because it came after three paragraphs of history, and two drivers never confirmed. So this time the first line reads: we need two drivers for Sunday, please confirm by Friday noon. The history of the food drive, the old route and the parking rules come afterwards, as background, for anyone who wants them. She added that nobody would complain if the message were shorter.

prompt.es: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué da a entender Sara sobre el mensaje del mes pasado?

choices.text: Its request was easy to miss because of the way it was organised.
Its readers were careless and ignored every message she wrote.
Its background was too short to explain the situation properly.

feedback.es: Sara atribuye el fallo a la estructura del mensaje (la petición llegaba tras tres párrafos), no a la falta de atención general ni a un contexto escaso.

origin.audio: At Monday's volunteers' meeting, Sara explained why she had revised the weekly message. Last month, she said, half the group missed the request because it came after three paragraphs of history, and two drivers never confirmed. So this time the first line reads: we need two drivers for Sunday, please confirm by Friday noon. The history of the food drive, the old route and the parking rules come afterwards, as background, for anyone who wants them. She added that nobody would complain if the message were shorter.

prompt.es: Completa: «Muchos lectores solo leen la primera línea, así que empieza por tu petición.»

feedback.es: Lead with + petición es la colocación para abrir un mensaje con lo esencial; start y open también funcionan con with.

origin.text: Most readers read only the first line, so ___ with your request and leave the background until later.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La conclusión principal es que aún faltan dos voluntarios.»

answer.text: The bottom line is that we still need two volunteers

feedback.es: Después de The bottom line is that viene una oración completa con sujeto y verbo: la idea que el lector debe recordar.

prompt.es: Lee el mensaje de Leo: ¿qué defecto tiene según lo aprendido en la clase?

choices.text: The writer sounds too blunt when he asks for help.
The request appears only after a long stretch of background.
The deadline is given, but the day of the event is missing.

feedback.es: Leo cuenta primero el contexto del año pasado y deja la petición para el final, así que el plazo se puede pasar por alto; el día del evento sí aparece.

origin.text: Hi team, I hope you had a good weekend. Last time we ran the collection, traffic was terrible and the school gate was closed, which delayed everything by an hour. Anyway, in case it is useful, we could use two more volunteers on Saturday at nine, and it would be great to know by Thursday.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué da a entender Tom sobre quien no responda esta noche.

choices.text: They will receive a second reminder at six.
They can still board the coach at half past.
Their place may go to another person.

feedback.es: Si no hay confirmación, Tom dará la plaza a alguien de la lista de espera; la hora del autobús cambió a las ocho.

origin.audio: Right, a quick one from Tom. I'm sorry this is last minute, but the coach leaves at eight, not half past. Could everyone who said yes please confirm again by six tonight? If I don't hear from you, I'll assume you can't come and offer your place to someone on the waiting list.

prompt.es: Completa: «Todo sobre el menú es útil, pero no es esencial para que el lector actúe.»

feedback.es: Essential es lo que el lector necesita para actuar; el resto es detalle y puede esperar al final.

origin.text: Everything about the lunch menu is useful, but it is not ___ for the reader to act, so it can wait until the end.

es: Condensar frases con elipsis, sustitución con one, cláusulas relativas reducidas y nominalización sin perder claridad, y saber qué omitir al resumir.

teaching.en: Tom will attend the planning meeting if he can, and Sara will too, but neither of them has confirmed a time yet.
teaching.es: Tom asistirá a la reunión de planificación si puede, y Sara también, pero ninguno de los dos ha confirmado todavía una hora.
teaching.explanationEs: Tras will se omite «attend the planning meeting»: el lector ya lo sabe. Repite solo el auxiliar.
segments: Tom will attend the planning meeting if he can, and Sara
will too, but neither of them has confirmed a time yet.
teaching.audioText: Tom will attend the planning meeting if he can, and Sara will too, but neither of them has confirmed a time yet.

teaching.en: I prefer the morning session and Mia the evening one, which saves us from repeating the whole sentence twice.
teaching.es: Yo prefiero la sesión de la mañana y Mia la de la tarde, lo que nos evita repetir toda la frase dos veces.
teaching.explanationEs: Se omite «prefers» en la segunda parte, y one sustituye a «session» para no repetirlo.
segments: I prefer the morning session and Mia the evening one,
which saves us from repeating the whole sentence twice.
teaching.audioText: I prefer the morning session and Mia the evening one, which saves us from repeating the whole sentence twice.

teaching.en: The guests invited to the launch, most of them clients, must reply today, otherwise the caterer cannot finalise the numbers.
teaching.es: Los invitados al lanzamiento, la mayoría clientes, deben responder hoy; de lo contrario, el catering no puede cerrar las cifras.
teaching.explanationEs: Invited a la derecha del nombre sustituye a «who were invited»: se quitan who were.
segments: The guests invited to the launch, most of them clients,
must reply today, otherwise the caterer cannot finalise the numbers.
teaching.audioText: The guests invited to the launch, most of them clients, must reply today, otherwise the caterer cannot finalise the numbers.

teaching.en: The players were disappointed by the decision to postpone until further notice, and the delay in rescheduling could make matters worse.
teaching.es: Los jugadores quedaron decepcionados por la decisión de aplazar hasta nuevo aviso, y el retraso en reprogramarlo podría empeorar las cosas.
teaching.explanationEs: Decision to + verbo y delay in + -ing convierten acciones en nombres: la frase queda más compacta.
segments: The players were disappointed by the decision to postpone until further
notice, and the delay in rescheduling could make matters worse.
teaching.audioText: The players were disappointed by the decision to postpone until further notice, and the delay in rescheduling could make matters worse.

teaching.en: Try to pare down a long update: it can usually boil down to one request, so streamline it and keep only the reason and the date.
teaching.es: Intenta recortar una actualización larga: suele reducirse a una sola petición, así que simplifícala y deja solo el motivo y la fecha.
teaching.explanationEs: Pare down y streamline son verbos de edición; boil down to + nombre indica a qué se reduce la idea.
segments: Try to pare down a long update: it can usually boil down to
one request, so streamline it and keep only the reason and the date.
teaching.audioText: Try to pare down a long update: it can usually boil down to one request, so streamline it and keep only the reason and the date.

teaching.en: They asked me to shorten the speech and leave out the jokes, but cutting words should never reduce clarity about who does what.
teaching.es: Me pidieron acortar el discurso y omitir los chistes, pero recortar palabras nunca debe reducir la claridad sobre quién hace qué.
teaching.explanationEs: Leave out es omitir lo que sobra; comprimir no debe crear ambigüedad sobre el sujeto.
segments: They asked me to shorten the speech and leave out the jokes,
but cutting words should never reduce clarity about who does what.
teaching.audioText: They asked me to shorten the speech and leave out the jokes, but cutting words should never reduce clarity about who does what.

prompt.es: Elige la versión condensada que conserva el contraste entre los dos grupos de delegados.

choices.text: The delegates invited to the launch had to reply by Friday; those not invited were told afterwards.
The delegates inviting to the launch had to reply by Friday; those not inviting were told afterwards.
The delegates invited to the launch had to reply by Friday; those invited were told afterwards.

feedback.es: Invited sustituye a «who were invited» y el contraste se mantiene con those not invited; las otras versiones cambian el sentido, lo hacen contradictorio o no son gramaticales.

hint.es: Quita who were y comprueba que siga habiendo dos grupos distintos.

origin.text: Report extract: The delegates who were invited to the launch had to reply by Friday. The delegates who were not invited were told about the event afterwards.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ana asistirá al lanzamiento del viernes y Leo también.»

feedback.es: Tras and se omite el resto y se repite solo el auxiliar de la primera parte: will attend se reduce a will.

hint.es: Repite solo el auxiliar de la primera parte de la frase.

origin.text: Ana will attend the launch on Friday, and Leo ___, too.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La decisión de aplazar el viaje sorprendió a todos.»

answer.text: The decision to postpone the trip surprised everyone

feedback.es: La nominalización decision to + verbo convierte la acción en el sujeto de la frase.

hint.es: Empieza por The decision to + verbo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué provocó la pérdida del cliente según el informe.

choices.text: The decision itself, which most managers opposed.
The late delivery that came after the smaller order.
The managers' preference for waiting a little longer.

feedback.es: Según el informe, fue el retraso en la entrega posterior al pedido reducido lo que costó el cliente; la decisión y la espera son el contexto.

origin.audio: The report says the decision to reduce the order was taken in May, and the delay in delivery that followed cost the company a client. Some managers argued against the decision at the time, but most of them preferred to wait and see.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase reducida con su significado completo.

pairs.es: la carta que se envió el lunes

pairs: The decision to reduce the order

pairs.es: lo que se decidió: reducir el pedido
el equipo al que se invitó a cenar

feedback.es: El participio -ed tiene valor pasivo y el -ing valor activo; decision to + verbo nombra lo que se decidió.

pairs.es: la carta que se envió el lunes

pairs: The decision to reduce the order

pairs.es: lo que se decidió: reducir el pedido
el equipo al que se invitó a cenar

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión condensa el borrador y conserva todo su significado?

choices.text: The volunteers working on Sunday and Monday will both get lunch, although Sunday's will be smaller.
The volunteers working on Sunday and Monday will get lunch.
The volunteers working on Sunday and Monday will both get lunch, although Monday's will be smaller.

feedback.es: Hay que conservar que ambos grupos comen y que el almuerzo del lunes es menor: invertir los días cambia el sentido y omitir el contraste pierde información.

origin.text: Draft: The volunteers who are working on Sunday, and the volunteers who are working on Monday, will both get lunch, although the lunch on Monday will be smaller than the lunch on Sunday.

prompt.es: Completa sin repetir el nombre: «la segunda era mejor para un equipo pequeño.»

feedback.es: One sustituye a proposal tras el adjetivo second y evita repetir el nombre en la misma frase.

origin.text: We received two proposals. I liked them both, but the second ___ was clearly better suited to a small team.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión comprime la primera frase sin perder la relación causa-efecto?

choices.text: The supplier's delay in delivering the equipment led us to postpone the launch.
The supplier's decision to postpone the equipment delayed the launch.
Our decision to delay the equipment led the supplier to postpone the launch.

feedback.es: La nominalización delay in delivering mantiene al proveedor como causa y el aplazamiento como consecuencia; las otras invierten agentes o causas.

origin.text: Extract from the project report: Because the supplier delayed the delivery of the equipment, we decided to postpone the launch, which disappointed the clients who had been invited to the opening. The managers who were responsible for the messages have since drafted a short statement, and the statement that was sent on Monday explains that the launch will now take place in June. Some board members, who were unhappy about the delay, have asked us to reduce the budget for the event, although nobody has confirmed a figure.

prompt.es: Según el informe, ¿qué da a entender sobre los miembros de la junta?

choices.text: They want the launch to be cancelled completely.
They hold the delay against the event and want less spent on it.
They have already agreed a new figure for the budget.

feedback.es: El informe dice que están descontentos con el retraso y piden reducir el presupuesto, pero nadie ha confirmado ninguna cifra ni se habla de cancelar.

origin.text: Extract from the project report: Because the supplier delayed the delivery of the equipment, we decided to postpone the launch, which disappointed the clients who had been invited to the opening. The managers who were responsible for the messages have since drafted a short statement, and the statement that was sent on Monday explains that the launch will now take place in June. Some board members, who were unhappy about the delay, have asked us to reduce the budget for the event, although nobody has confirmed a figure.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los invitados a la boda deben confirmar hoy.»

answer.text: The guests invited to the wedding must confirm today
accepted: The guests invited to the wedding must confirm today
Today the guests invited to the wedding must confirm

feedback.es: Invited a la derecha del nombre reduce «who were invited» y la frase sigue con el verbo principal.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué da a entender la directora sobre el retraso.

choices.text: That Tom and Mia should both take the early shift.
That the team will vote on the shifts next week.
That waiting for an agreement was costing the team time.

feedback.es: La directora reprocha el retraso en acordar el horario y decide asignar ella los turnos; Tom y Mia solo exponen sus preferencias.

origin.audio: Tom prefers the early shift and Mia the late one. The manager listened to both of them, then said that, honestly, the delay in agreeing a timetable had already cost the team a whole week, so she would simply assign the shifts herself.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Podrías recortarlo a tres frases sin perder las fechas?»

feedback.es: Pare down es la colocación para recortar un texto hasta lo esencial sin perder la información clave.

origin.text: The summary is far too long. Could you ___ it down to three sentences without losing the dates?

prompt.es: Este mensaje comprimido confunde por sus pronombres: ¿qué duda tendría el lector?

choices.text: Who promised the files: Mia, Ana or Sara?
When exactly did Mia phone Ana about it?
Why were the files not ready by Friday?

feedback.es: El pronombre she puede referirse a tres mujeres: al comprimir hay que cuidar que quede claro quién hace qué.

origin.text: Message: Mia phoned Ana after she had spoken to Sara, and she promised to send the files on Friday, although she hadn't got them yet.

es: Extraer de una nota de voz larga la decisión, la petición (también la implícita) y lo prescindible, apoyándote en marcadores de resumen y leyendo entre líneas.

vocabulary.es: en fin, a lo que iba

teaching.en: She tends to go off on a tangent about the traffic, but, anyway, the upshot is that we leave on Friday morning.
teaching.es: Suele irse por las ramas con el tráfico, pero, en fin, lo esencial es que salimos el viernes por la mañana.
teaching.explanationEs: Go off on a tangent es desviarse del tema; anyway vuelve a lo principal y the upshot is that da la conclusión.
segments: She tends to go off on a tangent about the traffic,
but, anyway, the upshot is that we leave on Friday morning.
teaching.audioText: She tends to go off on a tangent about the traffic, but, anyway, the upshot is that we leave on Friday morning.

teaching.en: Basically, Dad has decided, and all we have to do now is book the tickets by Tuesday, preferably the cheaper ones.
teaching.es: Básicamente, papá ya ha decidido y lo único que tenemos que hacer ahora es reservar los boletos antes del martes, mejor los más baratos.
teaching.explanationEs: Basically resume: primero la decisión, después la tarea. Book significa aquí reservar.
segments: Basically, Dad has decided, and all we have to do now
is book the tickets by Tuesday, preferably the cheaper ones.
teaching.audioText: Basically, Dad has decided, and all we have to do now is book the tickets by Tuesday, preferably the cheaper ones.

teaching.en: You can skip anything she mentions in passing, such as the traffic, because it changes neither the plan nor your own task.
teaching.es: Puedes saltarte todo lo que menciona de pasada, como el tráfico, porque no cambia ni el plan ni tu propia tarea.
teaching.explanationEs: Lo prescindible es lo que no altera ni la decisión ni tu tarea. In passing indica que se dice sin darle importancia.
segments: You can skip anything she mentions in passing, such as the
traffic, because it changes neither the plan nor your own task.
teaching.audioText: You can skip anything she mentions in passing, such as the traffic, because it changes neither the plan nor your own task.

teaching.en: I wonder whether anyone has a spare key, which from her is not idle curiosity but a request disguised as a question.
teaching.es: Me pregunto si alguien tiene una llave de repuesto, lo que en su boca no es simple curiosidad, sino una petición disfrazada de pregunta.
teaching.explanationEs: I wonder whether… suele ser una petición disimulada: espera que alguien se ofrezca.
segments: I wonder whether anyone has a spare key, which from her
is not idle curiosity but a request disguised as a question.
teaching.audioText: I wonder whether anyone has a spare key, which from her is not idle curiosity but a request disguised as a question.

teaching.en: When she says it would be great if someone called the hotel, that is a hint, so learn to read between the lines and act.
teaching.es: Cuando dice que sería estupendo que alguien llamara al hotel, eso es una insinuación, así que aprende a leer entre líneas y actúa.
teaching.explanationEs: La petición implícita no usa please ni can you, pero espera una acción. Read between the lines es captar lo no dicho.
segments: When she says it would be great if someone called the hotel, that
is a hint, so learn to read between the lines and act.
teaching.audioText: When she says it would be great if someone called the hotel, that is a hint, so learn to read between the lines and act.

teaching.en: The gist of the voice note is simple: long story short, the flight has changed and we need a new plan by tonight.
teaching.es: La idea general de la nota de voz es sencilla: resumiendo, el vuelo ha cambiado y necesitamos un plan nuevo para esta noche.
teaching.explanationEs: The gist es lo que queda si quitas los detalles; long story short anuncia un resumen.
segments: The gist of the voice note is simple: long story short, the
flight has changed and we need a new plan by tonight.
teaching.audioText: The gist of the voice note is simple: long story short, the flight has changed and we need a new plan by tonight.

prompt.es: Elige la conclusión (the upshot) del mensaje.

choices.text: The taxi driver recommended a hotel in Portugal.
They will spend the night at the aunt's house.
They will keep looking for a hotel tonight.

feedback.es: Tras anyway, the upshot is that… llega la conclusión: dormirán en casa de la tía; lo demás es relato previo.

hint.es: Busca lo que sigue a «the upshot is that».

origin.text: I spent ten minutes looking for the hotel, and then the taxi driver told me about his holiday in Portugal. Anyway, the upshot is that we are sleeping at my aunt's house tonight, and I wonder whether someone could tell Grandma.

prompt.es: Completa: «Básicamente, solo hay que reservar los asientos antes de que suban.»

feedback.es: Book también es un verbo: reservar una plaza, un boleto o una mesa; reserve es la versión más formal.

hint.es: Es el verbo que significa reservar una plaza.

origin.text: Forget the details of the trip. Basically, we just need to ___ the seats before the prices go up.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál de estas frases pide algo de forma implícita?

choices.text: We are getting to the station at six, and the train leaves at seven.
Someone drove us to the station last week, which was very kind.
It would be great if someone could drive us to the station at six.

feedback.es: It would be great if someone could… deja que alguien se ofrezca: pide una acción sin please ni can you.

hint.es: Una petición implícita espera que alguien se ofrezca.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la idea principal de la nota.

choices.text: The concert will take place on another day and in another place.
The concert is cancelled and the tickets will be refunded.
